material_definitions: A systematic study of solid solutions $\text{Li}_{1+x}M_{x}\text{Ti}_{2-x}(\text{PO}_4)_3$ with M=Al, Cr and Fe and $0 \le x \le 1$ has been carried out.
The analysis involved X-ray and neutron powder diffraction and impedance spectroscopy to relate electrical properties to crystal structure observations.
The highest conductivity was found in the sample $\text{Li}_{1.3}\text{Al}_{0.3}\text{Ti}_{1.7}(\text{PO}_4)_3$.
warnings: Temperature of 25 C is inferred from 'room temperature' description.

material_definitions: The materials investigated are Li-ion conducting solid solutions based on LiTi2(PO4)3 with the general formula Li(1+x)MxTi(2-x)(PO4)3, where M can be Al, Fe, or Cr.
The charge dynamics were investigated using complex impedance measurements across wide ranges of frequency and temperature to separate bulk dc and grain boundary conductivity mechanisms.
Bulk and grain boundary conductivity values were calculated from combined conductivity and modulus representations.
This sample (x=0.3 in Al substituted series) showed the maximum conductivity among the tested compositions.
warnings: Temperature value (25 Celsius) is inferred from the term 'room temperature'.
